recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5661 unless PA later reopens the broader active or entered-in-error policy across Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, and Organization.
issue_request: FHIR-5661 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request from DSTU1 asking to add an active property to Practitioner, consistent with Patient and Organization, for Practitioner records created in error. The resolution says the active flag was added and usage notes were added to explain its interaction with PractitionerRole.period.

additional_context: Practitioner is listed as an active approved resource in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has Practitioner.active as a 0..1 boolean summary modifier with a created-in-error requirement and PractitionerRole.period guidance, and the Practitioner-active search parameter points to Practitioner.active. Later PractitionerRole-specific Jira issues found during the search do not reverse or require changes to Practitioner.active.
